lines.text_source: I love these plants! So pretty!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.intent: expressar entusiasmo e admiração pelas plantas
lines.base_translation: Eu amo essas plantas! Que lindas!

lines.text_source: Some plants like these would look great in my garden!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.intent: imaginar como as plantas ficariam no jardim pessoal
lines.base_translation: Umas plantas assim ficariam show no meu jardim!

lines.text_source: I could spend hours just relaxing by the greenery!
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.intent: expressar relaxamento e contemplação na natureza
lines.base_translation: Eu ficaria horas relaxando nesse verde!
